findings.detail: The filing contains separate June 30, 2023 and December 31, 2022 SOI schedules; the B01 population for report_date 2023-06-30 includes 202 leaves but only 106 current-period fair values.

rationale: B01 reports 106 of 202 leaves with fair_value (52.5%) for the 2023-06-30 quarter. Raw source is readable and shows the June 30, 2023 SOI total fair value in table 6 row 40, while a separate December 31, 2022 comparative SOI total appears in table 13 row 40. The flagged missing-current-fair-value population is therefore a real current-period extraction/scoping error, not an unavailable source value.
